gen-gf-warnes-gf-heebo: The body text reads cleanly, curves stopping short instead of closing in, beneath Warnes in its wide, contrast-free letters. Heebo keeps the page quiet while the heading's tapered ink strokes do the shouting.

gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-mysuru: Loud, stretched and unshaded: Warnes tapers its ink strokes away before they touch. Hind Mysuru handles the reading, its lowercase pressing close to ascender height with no calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-siliguri: Stretched out and inky: Warnes tapers its strokes away before they touch, with no contrast anywhere in the letters. Hind Siliguri hums along beneath it at a constant line weight.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-vadodara: Clean text lines sit under a loud, stretched heading. Warnes tapers its ink strokes away before they touch, while Hind Vadodara keeps a constant thickness and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight runs its lines like bent rope, ascenders barely clearing the lowercase, beneath Warnes, a stretched bold display face. Inter Tight reads steadily across paragraphs, its curve tails held well back from the body.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-khula: Modern but loud, Warnes tapers its ink strokes away before they touch, with no contrast and wide spacing. Khula steps in below with a full-bellied midsection and curves that hold their mouths open.
